evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks a point grid read as cells around its nodes, and a window keeping each value at its node; EGM2008 read from cdn.proj.org at the Manila gauge gives 43.009 m bilinearly, PROJ's value. 0.7.1: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs checks the Inspector asks no country, and Configure… offers WorldPop for Botswana from the area, or says to set the country on the area; Chromium. 0.7.2: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs chooses Botswana in the dialog, finds the download link, and finds the country kept on the study area; Chromium. 0.8.0: tests/area-countries.browser.mjs (two countries offered, the one-file limit said, the area's list left as it was).
